title: Selling Plans Desk Guidance — Fee Credits on Seller-Funded Refunds
content:
## Guidance

On **Selling Plans**, a refund the seller funds for a buyer, debited to the seller's Northloop Payments account, earns a refund credit on the variable final value fee record of the refunded order, booked with the order refund credit reason; an order the seller cancelled before it shipped is credited under the cancellation credit instead and earns no refund credit.

| Situation on the records | Refund credit earned |
|---|---|
| A seller-funded refund for the order is debited to the seller's Northloop Payments account | Yes — on the order's variable final value fee record, with the order refund credit reason |
| The order is one the seller cancelled before it shipped | No — it is credited under the cancellation credit instead |

The observable effect of a refund credit is a credit listed against the order's fee, dated the day it is booked; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given.

## Booking tool: `book_refund_fee_credit_a1b0f084`

**Capability.** Books one seller fee credit, with the credit reason given, against the variable final value fee record of an order the seller refunded to the buyer out of the payments balance. The record carries the credit before any administration fee, the administration fee withheld and the credit actually given; the plan's net seller fees billed fall by the credit given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_refund_fee_credit_a1b0f084` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fee_event_ref` | The fee reference number of the refunded order's variable final value fee record being credited, as shown in the seller fee lookup | Id |
| `credit_reason` | Why the credit is given | Exactly one of `order_refund` (money taken back from the seller for the order, by a seller-funded refund or by a chargeback), `order_cancellation` (an order the seller cancelled while it was unshipped), `fee_dispute_upheld` (a seller fee dispute decided in the seller's favour) |
| `gross_credit_amount` | The credit before the administration fee | USD, a non-negative amount to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `refund_admin_fee_amount` | The administration fee withheld from the credit | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 when none |
| `credit_amount` | The credit actually given to the seller | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `credit_id` (the fee reference of the new credit record), `fee_event_ref` (the credited fee record), `order_id` (the order of that fee record), `credit_reason` (the reason recorded), `gross_credit_amount`, `refund_admin_fee_amount` and `credit_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date). A receipt carrying a `credit_id` means the credit is booked.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Called with a fee reference, `order_refund`, 12.00, 2.40 and 9.60, the tool returns a receipt with a new `credit_id`, those three amounts and today's date as `event_date`.
